---
name: html-css-generator
description: "Use when editing the GENERADOR 2 website project: HTML files, responsive CSS, layout updates, and content consistency."
applyTo:
  - "**/*.html"
  - "assets/styles/**/*.css"
  - "*.code-workspace"
---

This custom agent is tailored for the GENERADOR 2 workspace. Use it when you want focused help with:

- HTML structure and page content in `Inicio.html`, `generador-*.html`, `dashboard-*.html`
- CSS styling and responsive behavior in `assets/styles/`
- preserving Spanish labels, file names, and existing page patterns
- avoiding unrelated global changes outside the project scope

If you want, I can also create a user-level version in your VS Code prompts folder or extend this agent with a more specific focus such as form generation, accessibility fixes, or SEO improvements.
